basis: Production rolling RRULE continuation is proven, but epoch 59/60 evidence shows the verified completion-relative fallback has a theoretical utilization ceiling below P0 under a 600-second turn. UTIL-EXP-018 therefore tests predictive same-canonical prearm while retaining bounded cold rescue and single substantive authority.
same_canonical_overlap_assumption: PREDICTIVE WAKE OVERLAP MAY OCCUR, BUT SUBSTANTIVE AUTHORITY MUST NOT OVERLAP. NEWEST VERIFIED FUTURE DTSTART WINS AND STALE OCCURRENCES MAY NOT ROLL STATE BACK.
fallback_guarantee_target: If the active invocation disappears after provisional arming, retain a bounded future wake at the configured work horizon plus safety margin and scheduler jitter. If predictive canary is unsafe or missed, restore verified completion-relative rearm without replacing the canonical.

measurement.live_run_useful_span: Measure observed substantive boundaries; never infer hidden work.
measurement.recovery_gap: Measure last meaningful predecessor progress to first meaningful replacement progress for abrupt loss.
measurement.normal_continuation_gap: During predictive prearm, measure predecessor last useful boundary to successor first useful boundary and separately record predictive due to successor observation.
measurement.product_slo: Optimize wall-clock useful-work coverage union, not nominal turn count.
